name: io.github.yourappspace/yourappspace-mcp
description: MCP server for YourAppSpace Core: visual schema designer, data grid UI, REST APIs, and RLS/FLS.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ENTITY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Full user API key with the ip_api_key_ prefix (sent in X-Auth header)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ENTITY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional base URL override for self-hosted/Docker instances (defaults to https://core.yourappspace.com)
